terms.definition_en: The capability of computer systems to perform tasks that require human intelligence, such as learning from patterns and making decisions.
terms.definition_hinglish: Computer systems ki capability hai human intelligence ke zaroorat wale tasks perform karne ki, jaise patterns se sikhna aur decisions lena.

terms.definition_en: A step-by-step procedure or formula for solving a problem or accomplishing a task.
terms.definition_hinglish: Kisi problem ko solve karne ya kisi kaam ko complete karne ke liye ek step-by-step process ya formula.

terms.definition_en: The ability to identify recurring structures or regularities in data.
terms.definition_hinglish: Data mein aane wali repeated structures ya regularity ko pehchanne ki capability.

terms.definition_en: A subset of AI where systems learn and improve from experience without being explicitly programmed.
terms.definition_hinglish: AI ka ek subset jahan systems experience se seekhte hain aur khud ko improve karte hain bina explicitly program kiye.

terms.definition_en: A computing system inspired by biological neural networks that constitute animal brains.
terms.definition_hinglish: Ek computing system jo biological neural networks se inspire hai jo janvaron ke dimag bante hain.

terms.definition_en: A subset of machine learning using multiple layers of artificial neural networks.
terms.definition_hinglish: Machine learning ka ek subset jo multiple layers of artificial neural networks use karta hai.

terms.definition_en: The dataset used to train a machine learning model to recognize patterns.
terms.definition_hinglish: Wo dataset jo machine learning model ko patterns recognize karne ke liye train karne mein use hota hai.

terms.definition_en: A mathematical representation of learned patterns from training data.
terms.definition_hinglish: Training data se seekhe hue patterns ka mathematical representation.

terms.definition_en: AI systems that can create new, original content such as text, images, or code.
terms.definition_hinglish: AI systems jo nai, original content bana sakte hain jaise text, images, ya code.

terms.definition_en: A neural network model trained on massive amounts of text data to understand and generate human language.
terms.definition_hinglish: Ek neural network model jo bade amount of text data par train hua hai human language samjhne aur generate karne ke liye.

terms.definition_en: A neural network architecture that uses attention mechanisms to process sequences of data.
terms.definition_hinglish: Ek neural network architecture jo attention mechanisms use karta hai data sequences ko process karne ke liye.

terms.definition_en: A small unit of text, often a word or part of a word, that an AI model processes.
terms.definition_hinglish: Text ka ek chhota hissa, aksar ek shabd ya shabd ka kuch hissa, jo AI model process karta hai.

terms.definition_en: An input or instruction given to an AI model to generate a desired output.
terms.definition_hinglish: Ek input ya instruction jo AI model ko desired output generate karne ke liye diya jata hai.

terms.definition_en: A technique that retrieves relevant information from a database and uses it to enhance AI-generated responses.
terms.definition_hinglish: Ek technique jo database se relevant information retrieve karta hai aur use AI-generated responses ko better banana ke liye use karta hai.

terms.definition_en: When an AI model generates incorrect or fabricated information.
terms.definition_hinglish: Jab AI model galat ya jhootha information generate karta hai.

terms.definition_en: Numerical representations of words or concepts that capture their semantic meaning.
terms.definition_hinglish: Shabdon ya concepts ka numerical representation jo unka semantic meaning pakde.

terms.definition_en: A technique that allows neural networks to focus on the most relevant parts of input data.
terms.definition_hinglish: Ek technique jo neural networks ko input data ke sabse important parts par focus karne deta hai.

terms.definition_en: Learnable variables in a neural network that are adjusted during training.
terms.definition_hinglish: Neural network mein seekhne wale variables jo training mein adjust hote hain.

terms.definition_en: Complete passes through the entire training dataset during model training.
terms.definition_hinglish: Model training mein poore training dataset ke through complete pass karna.

terms.definition_en: A mathematical function that measures how far a model's predictions are from the actual data.
terms.definition_roman_ur: Ek mathematical function jo model ke predictions actual data se kitni door hain ye measure karta hai.
